title: Integral Lipschitz parametrization of a compactly supported integer multiplicity current
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsCompact X.support → ∃ R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, R.Represents X ∧ R.carrier ⊆ X.support ∧ R.measure univ ≠ ∞ ∧ ∃ (G : ℕ → Euclid n → Euclid P) (A : ℕ → Set (Euclid n)) (w : ℕ → Euclid n → ℤ) (c : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ), (∀ i, ∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L (G i)) ∧ (∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i)) ∧ (∀ i, Measurable (w i)) ∧ (∀ i, Measurable (c i)) ∧ (∀ i, ∀ u ∈ A i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (G i) u) ∧ (∀ i, G i '' A i ⊆ X.support) ∧ (∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun u => (w i u : ℝ)) (A i)) ∧ (∀ i, ∀ u ∈ A i, 0 ≤ c i u ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |α (fun a => fderiv ℝ (G i) u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))| ≤ c i u * covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ ∑' i, ∫⁻ u in A i, ENNReal.ofReal (|(w i u : ℝ)| * c i u) ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ γ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, HasSum (fun i => ∫ u in A i, (w i u : ℝ) * (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (G i u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ (G i) u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))) (X γ)
